summary: The crew is at dinner in the mess hall when MOUSE bursts into the room, interrupting the meal. He announces, "Morpheus is fighting Neo!" At this news, everyone abruptly bolts for the door.

what_changes.before: eating dinner, unaware of any fight
what_changes.after: informed that Morpheus is fighting Neo and rushing out
what_changes.evidence: MOUSE bursts into the room, interrupting dinner. MOUSE Morpheus is fighting Neo! All at once, everyone bolts for the door.

event_hint.one_line: Mouse interrupts dinner to announce the fight, sending everyone rushing out.

uncertain: Whether the crew goes to watch the fight or to intervene.
